messages:
Avery: Thanks for dropping follow-ups from todayall-hands. Use this thread for quick q's about mission, market positioning, roadmap clarifications, or competitor notes. I'll answer and tag folks.

Jordan: Short one: when we talk to procurement, should we lead with cost savings or operational risk reduction?

Sam: Lead with ops risk for enterprise RFPs (control, KMS, audit logs). For scale-ups/PLG motions, lead with cost predictability and performance guarantees. Two different playbooks.

Riya: On mission language  are we updating the public site copy to mention "inference economics" explicitly?

Avery: Not in the top-line mission. We'll add a subhead and a section on economics for buyers. Engineers keep the developer-first tone. Marketing will push the economics messaging in GTM assets for buyers.

Lee: Competitor question: if cloud providers offer lower GPU price, what is our defensive talking point?

Sam: Emphasize end-to-end service: guaranteed latency SLOs, rollout tooling (canary, A/B, automatic fallback), per-route observability, and provenance/compliance for private deployments. Price is only one axis.

Marta: Can we share a short one-pager on how our batching/caching reduces cost vs raw price-per-GPU? Sales needs something concise.

Riya: Yep. SEs/AE@sales will get a one-pager by EOD Friday. It will include a simple chart and two customer scenarios.

Jordan: Console roadmap: is request tracing still Q3?

Riya: Tracing internal alpha in Q2, public beta in Q3. Per-route cost breakdowns targeted Q3 as well.

Sam: For demos in the meantime, use the short script: attach per-request logs and show a simulated burst vs Dedicated autoscale. Code snippet to show fallback policy in sample config:

```json
{"route": "chat-prod", "fallback": ["redwood-l2", "redwood-l3"], "latency_slo_ms": 120}
```

Lee: Any change to Dedicated packaging? I heard about burst credits?

Avery: We're introducing a burst credit add-on and clearer committed tiers. No pricing overhaul now. Finance will publish the FAQ next week.

Marta: For competitor intel, please share any notes from recent meetings with ProspectX. They compared us to self-hosted runtimes.

Sam: ProspectX feedback: liked our unified API and rollout controls, concerned about vendor lock. Response: emphasize ability to private-deploy and export models; also show model version pinning + migration playbook.

deploy-bot: slide-deck uploaded to #docs at 1775002050 :white_check_mark:

Jordan: Thanks everyone. If there are follow-ups re: collateral, I'll coordinate with Sam and Riya.

Avery: Great thread  keep questions short here or DM for sensitive items. We'll leave this open for another 24h. :sparkles:
